electronics.intro: Headphones, TVs, computers, cameras, gaming gear, and the everyday tech that gets discounted often enough to be worth watching.
electronics.guidance: Model numbers matter. So do bundle contents and storage size. We care more about the exact item and the checked price than a dramatic list-price badge.
checklist: Match the exact model year, storage capacity and included accessories.
Check compatibility, seller and warranty terms.
Compare the final delivered price of the same configuration.

home-kitchen.intro: Cookware, small appliances, cleaning gear, storage, bedding, and the useful household stuff that is easy to overpay for.
home-kitchen.guidance: For appliances and home gear, the exact size and version can change the value fast. We favor clean price drops on products that are easy to compare like-for-like.
checklist: Compare capacity, dimensions and materials.
Check included attachments and replacement-part availability.
Measure the space and confirm the return policy.

sports-outdoors.intro: Fitness, camping, hiking, cycling, training gear, and outdoor equipment with a current price worth checking.
sports-outdoors.guidance: Outdoor pricing moves with season and inventory. Recent verification matters more here than an old percentage badge that looked great last week.
checklist: Check fit, dimensions and the activity the product is designed for.
Compare included equipment, weight and materials.
Check season-specific suitability before buying.

health-beauty.intro: Grooming, skincare, hair care, personal care, and other repeat-buy items where a real price cut can add up.
health-beauty.guidance: We judge the price, not whether a product is right for you. Check ingredients, directions, and product-specific claims on the retailer listing.
checklist: Match the exact formula, size and number of containers.
Compare cost per ounce or use, including shipping.
Read the manufacturer’s directions and ingredients.

toys-games.intro: Toys, board games, puzzles, hobby products, and family entertainment without the holiday-season price fog.
toys-games.guidance: Toy prices can swing hard around promotions. We put more weight on a recent checked price than on a giant crossed-out number.
checklist: Match the edition, language and included pieces.
Check age guidance and any required accessories.
Compare the same set and seller, including delivery.

baby.intro: Feeding, nursery, travel, care, and toddler essentials—especially the things families end up buying again and again.
baby.guidance: A lower price never replaces a safety check. Verify age guidance, recalls, fit, and manufacturer instructions before buying.
checklist: Check age, weight and size requirements for the exact product.
Compare pack quantities and price per item.
Check manufacturer instructions and current recall information.

pet-supplies.intro: Pet gear, food, care items, accessories, and the repeat purchases where unit price usually tells the real story.
pet-supplies.guidance: Pack size and recurring-purchase economics matter more than a headline discount. Compare the amount you are actually getting.
checklist: Match the formula, animal size and quantity.
Compare cost per pound or item with the same unit.
Check delivery and subscription terms separately.

automotive.intro: Car accessories, maintenance gear, tools, electronics, and vehicle essentials with current verified price drops.
automotive.guidance: Fitment comes first. Check model year, dimensions, connector type, and installation requirements before treating a low price as a good buy.
checklist: Confirm fitment for your vehicle’s year, make and model.
Check connector type, dimensions and installation needs.
Compare kit contents and the final delivered price.

tools-home-improvement.intro: Power tools, hand tools, hardware, lighting, repair supplies, and project gear with enough of a price move to notice.
tools-home-improvement.guidance: Compare exact model numbers, battery platforms, kit contents, and included accessories. Near-identical tool listings can be very different deals.
checklist: Match the model number and battery platform.
Compare bare tools with kits that include batteries and chargers.
Check included accessories and warranty terms.

office-school.intro: Workspace gear, stationery, organization, school supplies, and useful desk equipment at better-than-usual prices.
office-school.guidance: Pack quantity and included accessories can completely change the effective price. Compare the actual configuration, not just the title.
checklist: Count the usable items in each pack.
Check dimensions, compatibility and included accessories.
Compare unit price including delivery costs.

clothing-accessories.intro: Apparel, shoes, watches, bags, jewelry, and accessories where the deal may only apply to certain sizes or colors.
clothing-accessories.guidance: Variant pricing is the trap here. Confirm the exact size, color, and style you want before assuming the displayed discount applies.
checklist: Choose your exact size, color and style before comparing prices.
Check material, sizing guidance and seller.
Confirm return conditions for the selected variant.

grocery.intro: Pantry items, snacks, beverages, household staples, and consumables where a good unit price beats a flashy percentage.
grocery.guidance: Look at unit price, pack count, subscription terms, and shipping eligibility. Those details usually matter more than the headline discount.
checklist: Match product size, count and variety.
Compare price per ounce, pound or serving in the same unit.
Include shipping and check any subscription conditions.

other.intro: Good verified deals that do not fit cleanly into one of the main departments.
other.guidance: We would rather leave something in Other than force it into the wrong aisle. Cleaner classification makes the rest of the site easier to trust.
checklist: Match the exact product and variant.
Compare what is included and the final delivered price.
Check seller, return terms and the latest price-check time.
